title: Name Amendment Charge — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Fee Disclosure
content:
## The charge

A name amendment tells the ordering state the filed driver's new legal name, exactly as the reissued license prints it, when the customer reports a legal name change on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate. A name amendment is charged the name-amendment rate, which is 15.00 on every certificate type, and the name amendment charge is that rate booked to the cent.

The name amendment charge is the pending-version name charge plus the name-amendment envelope charge and the identity re-verification charge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once per name amendment, on its transmission.

| Element | Amount |
|---|---|
| Name-amendment rate | 15.00 on every certificate type |
| Pending-version name charge | The name-amendment rate |
| Name-amendment envelope charge | 0.00 |
| Identity re-verification charge | 0.00 |
| Name amendment charge | The three charges added together, rounded to the cent |

## Example

A name amendment on a Cardinal FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate: name-amendment rate 15.00; pending-version name charge 15.00; envelope 0.00; identity re-verification 0.00. Name amendment charge: **15.00**, booked once on the name amendment's transmission.

Two name amendments are two charges, each on its own transmission.
